title: Rural Family Portrait Outside Porch, 1920s Snapshot B&W Photo
description: A late 1920s black and white vintage snapshot photograph showing a rural American family standing outdoors beside the porch of their residence. A young man and boy are dressed in denim bib overalls with newsboy caps, standing alongside two women in traditional house dresses and aprons. The bottom margin of the front side features handwritten pencil reading 'Ma Rush'.
